name: Rapid Fire Commander
description: Quick toggle for built-in rapid-fire mode; use only where allowed.
author: Tavros Baker
code: const remove=xlinkWorkshop.addCheat("Rapid Fire Commander","Quick toggle for built-in rapid-fire mode; use only where allowed.",async()=>{const choice=prompt('Enter on or off for Rapid Fire Commander','on');if(!choice)return;if(!['on','off'].includes(choice.toLowerCase()))throw Error('Choose on or off');await xlink.command("cheat rapid"+' '+choice.toLowerCase())});return remove;
